worker_lifecycle_audit.safety: Private synchronous broadcast erases only callback lifetime. Pending guard waits for completion acknowledgements after callback return/unwind before borrowed stack values can be dropped. Partial pool construction joins already-created workers. OS spawn/allocation errors propagate; unexpected dead-worker channel invariants abort to avoid stranding borrowed callbacks. Worker indices remain native slots, not independent process samples.

population_audit.scope: Sample budget, wave reconstruction and separation from inferential resampling; native behavior, not numerical identity to upstream.
population_audit.upstream: Divan 0.1.21 src/benchmark/mod.rs:674-707 records full samples on each worker; 774-805 inserts per-worker duration and decrements the remaining sample count for each worker. A synchronized batch can therefore exceed the requested count. Criterion 0.8.2 src/routine.rs derives iteration schedules from warmup cost.
native_mapping: SampleCountUnit::Workers rounds requested samples up to complete synchronized batches; Batches counts aggregate observations. Both preserve requested count in the contract.
Fresh-input threaded paths use waves of up to 64 operations. Complete worker-slot samples sum duration and operations over waves before division; wave records are not separate worker samples.

Descriptive worker statistics show complete slots separately by process. Aggregate wall statistics sum the maximum worker interval in each wave and divide by total operations across workers; these quantities intentionally differ.
Bootstrap uses normalized aggregate observations for a single process and process medians for multiple processes. It never promotes worker slots or waves to independent process repetitions.
Explicit total measurement target uses final calibration cost and integer ceiling; Criterion uses aggregate warmup cost. Budget is a target, not a hard completion deadline.
Zero sample/iteration counts disable a native case; disabled entries remain absent from selected lists. This presentation differs from upstream and is not API compatibility.
population_audit.deterministic_evidence: worker_slot_samples_sum_unequal_waves_before_normalization: 64 operations at 10 ns/op plus one at 100 ns/op yield 740/65 per worker, not equal-wave mean 55; aggregate is 740/130. Eight waves become four complete slots and two bootstrap units. Duplicating into a second process yields eight complete slots but two process-median units. Analysis preserves raw serialized data.
